arguments.script: const invoices = await call('billing.list_invoices', {}); const drafts = await call('billing.list_reminder_drafts', {}); session.set('invoiceSnapshot', invoices); session.set('draftBaseline', drafts); return {invoices, drafts};

const invoices = session.get('invoiceSnapshot'); const eligible = []; const skipped = []; for (const invoice of invoices) { if (invoice.status !== 'open' || invoice.dueDate >= '2026-10-23') { skipped.push({invoiceId: invoice.id, reason: invoice.status !== 'open' ? 'not open' : 'not overdue before cutoff'}); continue; } const customer = await call('billing.get_customer', {id: invoice.customerId}); if (customer.doNotContact === true) { skipped.push({invoiceId: invoice.id, reason: 'customer opted out'}); } else if (customer.doNotContact === false && customer.email) { eligible.push({invoiceId: invoice.id, to: customer.email, amountCents: invoice.amountCents, currency: invoice.currency}); } else { skipped.push({invoiceId: invoice.id, reason: 'contact eligibility uncertain', customer}); } } session.set('eligible', eligible); session.set('skipped', skipped); session.set('attempted', []); session.set('created', []); return {eligible, skipped};
